problem_type: Curated skill media loses its binding across projection and package transport
symptom: Packaged prompt previews resolve under dist/skills; text packages omit declared preview bytes but pass validation.
direct_cause: Projection constructs a renderer-relative disk path and text package validation checks frontmatter syntax without media completeness.
class_root: Media declarations need a shared serving boundary and transport must reject representations it cannot preserve.
affected_population: Built-in curated skills and future generated effect covers
Skills imported through JSON, folder or ZIP text maps
internal_only_reason: Internal disk layout and existing text-only import envelope; no dependency upgrade or external binary format is introduced.
invariants: Only a validated built-in preview declaration may resolve to bytes within its real skill directory.
Text-only packages cannot successfully import or export a binary preview declaration.
Curated intake has one license and applicability schema shared by discovery and imports.
generality_proof: Protocol requests select a built-in record by identity, never arbitrary file paths; realpath containment blocks symlinks. Import and export share package validation before transport.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Select only declared built-in media and enforce real directory containment.
Reject binary preview declarations in the text-only envelope.
Validate redistribution metadata once for both discovery and transport.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Projects the shared preview URL, independent of dist/index.html or dev HTTP origin.
Export validates through the same boundary as imports and returns no broken package.
Reads validated curation through the shared frontmatter parser.

recurrence.reason: Every later effect cover and every media-bearing skill export can reproduce this.
same_class_scan: rg mediaUrl electron/promptLibrary; inspected builtinPacks and userPromptStore
Inspected readSkillDirFiles, validateSkillPackage, exportSkillPackageByName and ZIP import text map
Inspected localProtocol and localRuntimeAssets; reused existing protocol streaming

prevention.invariant: Media identity resolves only to a declared file within its built-in skill; incomplete text transport fails closed.
prevention.failure_mode: 404 for unknown or escaping media; package validation error or null export for unsupported binary preview.
prevention.strategy: Use record identity and realpath containment, with one validation boundary for import/export.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed relative skills/ media address construction.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuses the existing local protocol and filesystem; no library version change.

migration: No user data migration. Existing plain skills remain importable. Media-bearing curated packages now reject unsupported text-only sharing instead of silently dropping preview bytes.
residual_risks: Binary media transfer through the existing text-only skill sharing envelope remains unsupported; this is explicitly rejected.
Real Electron packaged archive walkthrough is not performed; production streaming and packaged directory layout are tested.
